user.title: Octopus Energy Italia
user.description: Enter the email and password of your Octopus Energy Italy customer area. They are stored only in the Home Assistant configuration and sent only to api.oeit-kraken.energy.

reauth_confirm.description: Octopus rejected the stored credentials. Enter email and password again.

init.title: Prices for the cost statistics
init.description: The variable price, all included: energy, network, system charges, taxes and VAT, the part of the bill that changes with consumption. You find the items in the detail pages of the bill. Leave a field empty for no cost statistic. A new price applies from today: past days keep theirs.
